content_metadata.description: A video exploring the impact of AI on voice acting, focusing on concerns and actions taken by voice actors.

qAndA.question: What is the slogan used by the voice actors' coalition?

qAndA.answer: Voice cloning software, which can analyze and replicate human voices with increasing accuracy.
qAndA.question: What specific AI technology poses the "even bigger threat," according to the video?

qAndA.answer: The scene's upbeat and lighthearted animation clashes with the serious concerns about AI and job security, creating a jarring and somewhat confusing shift in mood.
qAndA.question: How does the scene with the animated Mexican man contrast with the overall tone of the video?

activities.description: Robot's face changes, text overlay describes voice actors taking a stand

mood.description: Anxious - The futuristic robot, coupled with the serious tone of the text and the dramatic music, creates a feeling of unease and concern about the future of voice acting.

scenes.thematicElements: Technology vs. Art, Job Security, Ethics of AI

videoEditingDetails.description: Title card with the phrase 'Dubbing artists decry AI threat' appears.
Transition to a close-up shot of the robot's face as the text changes.

activities.description: Two men sit in front of microphones in a recording studio.
Text overlay describes the 'Don't steal our voices' slogan and the formation of a voice actors coalition.

characterInteraction.description: The two voice actors are looking at each other and smiling, suggesting camaraderie and a shared experience.

mood.description: Proud, but with underlying concern - The visuals of voice actors actively working in their field convey a sense of pride in their craft. However, the text overlay about the coalition and the ongoing concern about AI creates a somewhat apprehensive undertone.

narrativeProgression.description: Shows the collective action voice actors are taking to address the AI threat.

scenes.thematicElements: Collective Action, Advocacy, Human Connection in the Face of Technological Advancement
scenes.title: Voice Actors Coalition

videoEditingDetails.description: Transition to a medium shot of two men in a recording studio.

activities.description: Footage of people walking through the United Nations building.
Text overlay presents a statement from a group including NAVA and the Organization of United Voices.

mood.description: Anxious -  The authoritative setting of the UN, the mention of 'extinction of artistic heritage,' and the lack of human faces in the footage contribute to a feeling of unease and potential loss.

narrativeProgression.description: Underscores the severity of the situation by bringing in the perspective of organizations like NAVA and the potential loss of artistic heritage.

scenes.thematicElements: Loss of Creativity, Institutional Concern, Irreplaceable Value of Human Expression
scenes.title: UN Perspective on AI Impact

videoEditingDetails.description: Transition to a long shot of the United Nations building interior.

activities.description: Footage of a serene river with houses on stilts.
Text overlay presents a quote from NAVA Vice President Carin Gilfry.

mood.description: Calm, but juxtaposed with the serious message in the text - The tranquil visuals of the river scene clash with the serious quote about voices being livelihoods.

narrativeProgression.description: Highlights the personal impact of AI on voice actors through a direct quote.

scenes.thematicElements: Livelihoods at Stake, Personal Stories, Contrast Between Technology and Traditional Ways of Life
scenes.title: Personal Impact of AI

videoEditingDetails.description: Transition to a peaceful scene of a river with houses.

activities.description: Black screen with text 'Now AI has brought an even bigger threat.'
Transition to a scene with people working on computers in an office setting.
Text overlay describes how AI software can clone voices.

mood.description: Anxious -  The text warning of a 'bigger threat' instantly increases the sense of unease. The visuals of people working with code further reinforce the idea of rapid technological advancement.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduces the concept of voice cloning and the increasing sophistication of AI technology.

scenes.thematicElements: Rapid Technological Advancement,  Potential for Misuse, Ethical Concerns of Voice Cloning
scenes.title: AI Cloning Threat

mood.description: Pensive, Uncertain - The imposing lion statue, often a symbol of strength and pride, evokes contemplation about the implications of Gonzalez's quote.

narrativeProgression.description: Emphasizes that while voice actors recognize the potential of AI, they are wary of the risks and demand ethical considerations.

scenes.thematicElements: Revolution vs. Exploitation,  Seeking Balance,  Protecting Artistic Integrity

videoEditingDetails.description: Cut to a shot of a large lion statue.

mood.description: Curious - The contemplative robot and invitation to learn more create a sense of curiosity and a desire for further information.

scenes.thematicElements: Ongoing Conversation, Invitation to Engage, AI as a Tool for Information and Connection

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: dubbing artists to cry A threat. Voice actors around the world are taking a stand against the
unregulated use of AI to generate and clone human voices, which they fear threatens their jobs.
Under the slogan don't steal our voices, over 20 voice acting guilds, associations and unions
from Europe, the US and Latin America have formed United Voice Artist Coalition. The use of AI
without limits and regulation is a risk that could lead to the extinction of an irreplaceable
artistic heritage of creativity and wonder, something machines can't manufacture,
according to a group with members including the US National Association of Voice Actors,
NAVA, and Latin America's Organization of United Voices. Our voices are our livelihood,
Navi Vice President Karin Gilfrey said last month. Now AI has brought an even bigger threat.
Thanks to machine learning, software can compare your voice with millions of others and
clone it by identifying patterns. McLevia Gonzalez, a Mexican voice artist, said she'd only
sign with an AI company if they gave enough info on how the content would be used.
I want to be part of this revolution, she said, but not at any price.
Thanks for watching. Visit our website for more AI news.
